rules: Missing data remains unknown, never zero or not-ready.
Comparable protocol and current readiness precede interpretation.
Pain/unknown pain and participation restrictions override development suggestions.
No automatic lineup, stage assignment, programme publication or workout dose.
Resolve canonical exercise IDs through existing exerciseCatalog; no new exercise authority.
Examples are candidate options, not prescriptions; field drills require separate role/space/contact metadata.

links.question: Is the first 10 m limiting rugby movement?
links.interpretation: Confirm consistent timing and look at sprint technique, force capacity and readiness before choosing a cause.
links.retest: Same sprint protocol plus rugby-specific first-step observation.

links.question: Can the player reach and use longer sprint speed?
links.interpretation: Separate acceleration, maximum-velocity exposure and speed while carrying/reading.
links.retest: Same distance and timing; field chase/cover evidence separately.

links.question: Does turning fail even when the direction is known?
links.interpretation: Review entry speed, braking steps, left/right task and control before inferring a strength deficit.
links.retest: Same 505 and matched-speed braking task.

links.question: Is planned turning adequate but attacker response poor?
links.interpretation: Investigate scanning, cues, choice and task familiarity; do not automatically prescribe more strength or ladder work.
links.retest: Same geometry/cue rules; record choice and movement separately.

links.question: Is explosive output limiting despite adequate movement and strength?
links.interpretation: Review jump method, training age, readiness and sport expression.
links.retest: Same jump method and field transfer task.

links.question: Is force capacity limiting safe role execution?
links.interpretation: Consider absolute and body-mass-relative capacity alongside technique and training history.
links.retest: Same lift/reps/range plus relevant contact or movement observation.

links.question: Does output fall across a fixed sequence?
links.interpretation: Check initial pace, completed reps, recovery, team load and conditioning before increasing density.
links.retest: Same complete series, start interval and timing; retain all rep times.

links.question: Can the athlete sustain and recover between efforts?
links.interpretation: Compare like protocols and role demands; general running capacity does not establish contact endurance.
links.retest: Same approved intermittent test; monitor match/training response.

links.question: What movement warrants follow-up?
links.interpretation: Observed compensation is not a diagnosis or proof of a specific muscle deficit.
links.retest: Repeat the same screen and relevant controlled field movement.

links.question: Which tackle stage breaks down?
links.interpretation: Review factual coach evidence at the stated role and pressure. Physical tests may inform capacity but cannot certify this skill.
links.retest: Repeat the same task and pressure; then seek independent live/field evidence when appropriate.
